shell.exception: The header, menu and footer are drawn by site/build.mjs and site/nav.mjs, not by sitekit. sitekit's chrome cannot serve this static site yet: measured 2026-11-12, it needs its own box model, links to other origins, a footer year that does not read the clock, a menu script that works without React, per-surface backgrounds and reflow at 200% text. The steps and their order are in ROADMAP.md, "Move the chrome to sitekit".

identity.exception: This site is static files and holds no accounts: a person's account is their Loki account. Until the header's account control ships from accountkit (AccountControl, with the session read from Loki), the only sign-in is a link to Loki's builder page. The steps are in ROADMAP.md, "Sign in from the studio site".

design.exception: @bitbaum/design-tokens is in use, but as files rather than an import: site/build.mjs copies the package's tokens.css and fonts into site/dist, and site/styles.css reads its variables. There is no module to import in a stylesheet built without a bundler, so no binding can be named in the form this plan checks.
